0.translation: Searching cuts and choosing a display subset are separate steps. Compare leaders, text content, order and side on the same three pUC19 hits, without editing DNA or cut coordinates.

1.translation: ## Retain cut coordinates and search assumptions ⟦shared:0⟧

2.translation: Run independently with explicit EcoRI, BamHI and HindIII and methylation="none". This is a search assumption, not a measurement of sample methylation. enzyme_site_count refers to the complete input sequence and survives display filtering.

7.translation: ## Compare leaders at the same cut sites ⟦shared:0⟧

8.translation: Default radial uses text bounds and circular order, with radial stubs and fan connections where needed. Elbow uses one bend; straight connects the tick tip to the final label edge. Only leader changes across the three figures; cut sites and label grouping are fixed.

15.translation: ## Change content, order and side separately ⟦shared:0⟧

16.translation: Each figure returns to the radial baseline, changing only label_style, label_order or label_side. Default bold enzyme names indicate one cut in the complete target; explicit fontface replaces that automatic distinction. Positions come from computed cleavage, not motif midpoints.

29.translation: | label_order | auto | auto/enzyme_position/position_enzyme; automatic mirrored ordering |

31.translation: | leader | radial | radial/elbow/straight; never changes cuts |

32.translation: | min_label_gap | NULL | Device-derived default; explicit genomic-fraction spacing |

35.translation: | linewidth / label_size | 0.28 / 3.2 | Stroke width versus text size |

36.translation: | fontface / family | NULL / NULL | Explicit fontface overrides unique-cutter bolding |

37.translation: find_restriction_sites returns matches and cuts; filter_restriction_sites selects a display set. unique, six_plus, unique_6plus and reference have different conditions. Reference uses saved sets only for exact reference targets. methylation=auto applies audited backgrounds only to exact built-in references; state assumptions for unknown samples.

39.translation: Increase only min_label_gap and inspect outward label/leader movement; then restore defaults and set label=FALSE for ticks only. Retain full search results separately from the display subset. Increase export dimensions instead of deleting source observations to fit a small image. Recheck crowding after combining features and primers in [dense pETDuet-1](⟦shared:0⟧). Computed cuts do not validate a digestion experiment.
